resources.string: Resync now fetches the latest catalogue and keeps everything already saved.\n\nResync and remove missing titles also allows removing titles the provider no longer lists. Your favourites, history and resume positions for titles that are still listed are kept.
Synced, but no programmes were found in the time window.
The startup channel is unavailable. Home was opened.
Choose what to remove for this profile. Playlists, favourites and downloads are not affected.
Download the programme guide (EPG) for “%1$s”. You can also do this later in Settings → Sources & guide → EPG Sources.
Default leaves the colour to the stream and the player.
Turn this on, then change only what you want — anything left on Default keeps the stock look, including the colours and placement broadcasters embed in Live TV subtitles.
Text colour — a preset, the picker, or a hex code.
Adds setup-style radiance to the solid interface
Adds a soft accent aura to the non-glass interface. Slow pulse gently breathes when animations are enabled.
Colour and thickness of the ring around the selected item
On your other device, turn Sync mode on too, then tap Connect and pick this one.
QR code with this device\'s address
Both devices must be on the same Wi-Fi, and the other one must have Sync mode on.
Point the camera at the code on your other device
Without the camera you can still pick the device from the list, or type its address.
Type the six digits shown on your other device. You only need to do this once.
Your data goes there. Nothing here changes.
Its data comes here. Nothing there changes.
Both devices end up with everything
You will need the PIN again next time
The same things a backup holds. Untick anything you would rather leave out.
Nothing has been changed yet. This is what applying it would do on this device.
Both devices already hold the same thing. There is nothing to apply.
Your own data is sent back afterwards, so both devices end up the same.
This device could not be reached. On it, open OwnTV → More → Local sync and turn Sync mode on. Both devices must be on the same Wi-Fi.
The other device refused. The PIN may be wrong, or it may have forgotten this device.
What arrived could not be read. If you used a password, check it is the same on both devices.
Find another device that has Sync mode on
Colour of the OwnTV icon and logo
You chose a new icon and logo. They take effect after OwnTV restarts.

On: Dolby and DTS go undecoded to the TV, soundbar or receiver when it says it can play them (ExoPlayer). Off: the app decodes them, still as surround where Surround sound allows. mpv always decodes. Not used while Night mode or Volume levelling is on.
Brings every channel and film slowly to the same loudness, so switching does not jump in volume.
The highest picture played when a channel or film offers several. Saves bandwidth and eases the decoder.
What happens when a programme you set a reminder for is about to start.
How long before the programme starts the reminder comes.
Hold OK on a channel, film or show and choose Add to Favourites.
Touch and hold a channel, film or show and choose Add to Favourites.
%1$s, %2$s, %3$s and every customisation live only on this TV.
%1$s, %2$s, %3$s and every customisation live only on this phone.
The ring drawn around whatever has focus. Pick its colour and thickness so it stays easy to follow from the sofa.
Add an XMLTV guide feed by its link, refresh it, or remove it. Feeds fill the TV Guide and the programme lines in Live TV.
How many days of programmemes the guide stores ahead. Fewer days make guide refreshes faster and the database smaller.

Catch-up plays programmes from your provider’s archive. Automatic uses the time zone your provider reports, or your TV’s own clock if it reports none; choose a fixed UTC offset if catch-up still starts at the wrong time. This is also where you choose which player catch-up uses.
Each viewer keeps their own favourites, watch history, resume points and Home rows. Kids mode shows only the categories you allow; a PIN stops anyone else from opening the profile.
A viewer with their own favourites, history and settings
What OwnTV shows when it starts: Home, the channel you watched last, your favourites, or a channel you pick.
Looks on GitHub for a newer OwnTV now and offers to install it. Your playlists, favourites and settings stay as they are.
OK opens the colour picker (presets, palette or a hex code), the same one as Accent colour. The preview follows as you move.
Stage draws OwnTV’s own soft colours. Picture shows a picture of yours behind every screen. Plain is a flat dark fill.
Your accent colour glows in the corner
The logo\'s play triangle in your accent colour
The OwnTV logo in the menu, About and setup shows its play triangle in your accent colour. The icon on the home screen keeps its own colours.
Hidden categories and items show again, renames and custom order are cleared, and moved-out items return. Combined categories, favourites and guide matches are kept.
